editor.title: 短剧剪辑
editor.subtitle: 在桌面 Chrome 或 Edge 里剪时间线，导出后再发布。
editor.unavailableHint: 该功能由后台开关控制。打开后可从已完成的视频任务进入剪辑。

editor.openFromJobHint: 完整路径：生成成功 → 进入剪辑 → 导出变体 → 绑定后再发布。不要从发布后的物料包倒回去剪。
editor.gateBrowserTitle: 请使用桌面版 Chrome 或 Edge

editor.previewMuted: 预览暂不播放原声，导出同样只处理画面。
editor.exportHint: 一次只编一条变体。导出在浏览器内完成，不计费。

editor.sequentialHint: 多条变体会排队，由本页按顺序认领。
editor.goldHint: 验证多实例引擎与桌面 Chrome/Edge 的 10 秒浏览器导出。未跑通不得宣称媒体验收通过。
editor.goldEnginesOk: 两个 EditorEngine 实例互不影响
editor.platformCallbackMissingParams: 回调参数缺失，请重新发起连接。

editor.title: Drama editor
editor.subtitle: Cut the timeline in desktop Chrome or Edge, then export before publishing.
editor.unavailableHint: This feature is behind a flag. When it is on, finished video jobs can enter the timeline.
editor.signInHint: Sign in to open the drama editor.
editor.emptySeriesHint: Start from a finished video job with Enter editor, or create an empty project here.
editor.openFromJobHint: Path: generation succeeds → editor → export variants → bind, then publish. Do not start from the post-publish kit.
editor.gateBrowserHint: Browser export needs WebCodecs, which we support in desktop Chrome and Edge only.
editor.gateDesktopTitle: Open this on a desktop-width screen
editor.gateDesktopHint: Narrow viewports only show this notice. Use a window at least 1024 pixels wide.
editor.leaseLost: Another tab holds the write lease. Refreshing will not overwrite the new head revision.
editor.leaseNotReady: This tab does not have write access yet. Try reclaiming it; if that fails, another tab still holds the lease.
editor.previewMuted: Preview has no audio yet; export currently renders picture only too.
editor.exportHint: One variant encodes at a time in the browser. Manual export is not billed.
editor.planEmpty: No executable commands this time. Change the goal or reject the plan.
editor.leaseLostHint: Stay read-only after losing the lease
editor.commandFailed: That command did not apply. The timeline is unchanged.
editor.brandOverlayHint: Add a brand overlay by asset ID from an existing upload; browsing your library here isn't supported yet.
editor.hardLimitHint: Cap: 30s, 1080p, ~80MB estimated memory. Larger jobs are refused.
editor.sequentialHint: Variants queue and this page claims them in order.
editor.goldHint: Prove independent EditorEngine instances and a 10-second Chrome/Edge encode. Do not claim media acceptance without this.
editor.goldEnginesOk: Two EditorEngine instances do not share state
editor.platformCallbackMissingParams: Missing callback parameters. Please start connecting again.
editor.platformConnectHint: Connect your Douyin or Kuaishou account to publish drama episodes in one click.
editor.platformNotConfiguredHint: This platform is not configured yet
editor.publishPanelHint: Pick the channels to publish to, then fill in a title and description.
editor.publishNotLinked: This platform account is not linked yet
editor.keyframesHint: Add a keyframe at the current playhead to animate this property over time.
editor.propertiesEmptyHint: Select a clip to see its properties
editor.transcribeReviewHint: Check each line for accuracy — uncheck a line to skip it.

createPage.modeDramaDesc: Drop a finished clip on the timeline, add captions and trims, then export to a delivery spec.
